name: IMEC Services Limited
about: IMEC Services Limited provides management and consultancy services in India. It operates through Service and Trading segments. The company offers consultancy services for information technology, engineering, and technical. It is also involved in the trading of agricultural products, metal, and metal alloys. The company was formerly known as Ruchi Strips and Alloys Limited and changed its name to IMEC Services Limited in October 2018. IMEC Services Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Indore, India.
